row.body:
I wrote down the sour smell after the field truck unloaded its rinse barrels. The meat was still cold when the flies vanished and the siren began.

I thought the date would settle it. When I asked, the person at the barrier looked at the seal instead and handed it back.

I wrote the time before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow; the second vehicle was already gone.

row.body:
The shopkeeper made me bring the parcel through the back. He said the front counter was closed to anyone who had been beyond the roadblock.

A visitor checked the wrapper but never asked what was inside. He took the slip with the customer name and left the parcel on the table. It began to drip while they argued about which list should keep the name.

I washed the table when they left. The parcel was still there, and I could not decide whether throwing it away counted as a sale.
row.title: A separate cut of meat

sidecar.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
sidecar.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
